LARP check of $TOLL on Robinhood Chain: product found.
2 claims read from its site. Four different working parts of it answered our own reads, among them: its API at t0ll.xyz/api/check answered with data (fields token, sym, name, supply); its MCP server at t0ll.xyz/mcp answered and listed 7 tools (check_coin, dev_record, wallet_privacy, fresh_launches).
Read 2026-10-26 16:57 UTC.

What it says, and what we found:
- found: "Read from the chain for any coin on Robinhood Chain, Solana, BSC and Arc. Free." (its site). its API at t0ll.xyz/api/check answered with data (fields token, sym, name, supply); its MCP server at t0ll.xyz/mcp answered and listed 7 tools (check_coin, dev_record, wallet_privacy, fresh_launches)
- found: "131 coins checked 20 launchpads 53% dead within 24 h" (its site). its API at t0ll.xyz/api/check answered with data (fields token, sym, name, supply); its MCP server at t0ll.xyz/mcp answered and listed 7 tools (check_coin, dev_record, wallet_privacy, fresh_launches)

Working parts we tested:
- API: answered. its API at t0ll.xyz/api/check answered with data (fields token, sym, name, supply) (https://t0ll.xyz/api/check?addr=0xff9e86e6b21fd688027981bee4b64c8b6b804ed3)
- MCP: answered. its MCP server at t0ll.xyz/mcp answered and listed 7 tools (check_coin, dev_record, wallet_privacy, fresh_launches) (https://t0ll.xyz/mcp)
- x402: answered. its x402 endpoint at t0ll.xyz/api/x402/larp/0xff9e86e6b21fd688027981bee4b64c8b6b804ed3 asks 0.05 USDG on Robinhood Chain; 0 payments in 3 days (chain) (https://t0ll.xyz/api/x402/larp/0xff9e86e6b21fd688027981bee4b64c8b6b804ed3)
- Chrome extension: answered. its Chrome extension “Toll: coin check for Solana, Robinhood Chain and Arc” is listed on the Chrome Web Store (https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/aclfobbnomcddmcldacomchepinloeeh)
- Telegram bot: exists. its Telegram bot @t0ll_bot exists, no monthly users shown (https://t.me/t0ll_bot)
- X account @Tollxyz_: exists (an account is not a working part; it backs no claim).
- The page we read: https://t0ll.xyz/ (declared at launch).

The claims are their own words, quoted by Claude Haiku 5.5; Claude Sonnet 5.5 checked each result against our evidence and Claude Opus 5.5 had the final say; every check of them is our own read, and chain facts come from the chain.
Facts, not a verdict: a quiet contract can be a product that launched yesterday, and a busy one can still lose you money. Not advice.
Holders of 1M $TOLL get re-reads, the second reader's notes and the dev's full record.
